index_title: Actual SAP-preserving character splits, RAW/STRONG boundaries and finite terminalisation
scope: Private B047: TEN selected remaining pair-level Ramsey I results and FIVE equations. Keep STRONG nonempty saturation separate from FULL represented closure/gates/primality. The actual maximal-character split has SAP by a direct infinite-type-fibre intersection argument using old SAP and infinite gate classes, applied to the homogeneous legal marked age; B044 AP is not relabelled SAP. Only afterwards identify lifted STRONG profiles and apply actual STRONG calculus. An extra old-SAP no-orthogonal-equivalences argument proves actual STRONG phase primality despite a possible RAW identity. The phase-sufficiency source is qualified to its standing ACTUAL character/FULL triangle context; a generic three-property abstract-sector theorem is not asserted. No later full-language theorem or new axiom/provider is used.
scope_explanation: statement and proof. Logical old Id is separate from whole K and its diversity slice. A RAW profile may have extra Id; deleting it does not by itself transfer phase primality. Prove actual SAP independently, then use old/new injectivisation for STRONG normal form.

assumptions.name: Actual current old homogeneous source
assumptions.statement: M is a countable homogeneous complete finite relational binary structure on finitely many inhabited named transitive current sorts, with symmetric same-sort atoms and correctly typed converses. Every named atom is an actual full-Aut pair orbital. Its age has semantic HOM CCO. Full represented products include logical identities; no identity is a diversity edge.

assumptions.name: Additional visible original SAP
assumptions.statement: The actual finite old age has SAP. Therefore its pointwise stabilizer has infinite orbits off any finite real base, by existing injectivisation support. This is used to show all active gate classes and every nonempty old-type/gate-class intersection are infinite. It is not inferred for an arbitrary quotient.

assumptions.name: Actual FULL old triangle age
assumptions.statement: The old age is exactly the complete finite networks whose actual unary/pair types and triangles are allowed, with no additional higher obstruction. This standing source context is essential when identifying the marked age with the FULL lifted triangle class. Empty/singleton/pair cases retain actual admissibility.

assumptions.name: Actual maximal exact character instance
assumptions.statement: Choose an original finite-relative-index interval and its reachable parity layer, then a maximal full exact complement K_*>=Y. Reach its actual quotient-functional bridge groupoid. The character sends its nonidentity transported odd involutions to one. Active vertex labels are constant on their original K_s-classes and satisfy all rigid-arrow equations; inactive sorts have fixed bit zero. All canonical interpretations and markings are actual, not an arbitrary table sector.

assumptions.name: Independent STRONG saturation context
assumptions.statement: For the isolated saturation theorem take nonempty STRONG exact gate palettes and finite STRONG exact domains D_i with NONEMPTY common intersection, in the original actual SAP+HOM CCO STRONG calculus. Products use three distinct formal vertices, and no adjoined equality atom. This theorem is not substituted for the RAW saturation API.

assumptions.name: Standard actual homogeneous relational age convention
assumptions.statement: Finite marked objects are actual old-age complete induced diagrams with legal unary bits, and their homogeneous Fraisse limit is constructed only after ordinary AP/JEP/HP. No arbitrary global seed marking is assumed homogeneous. All functions in the hereditary SAP criterion specialization are absent, hence closure(A)=A. Finite-language realized one-point qf types over finite real A are definable, and old invariant equivalences are finite unions of named atoms plus equality.

definitions.name: Two distinct product conventions
definitions.statement: FULL RAW composition is actual represented composition including Id; STRONG multiplication uses distinct formal triangle vertices and diversity outputs. Even in SAP one must guard endpoint inequality before comparison.

definitions.name: Nonempty STRONG exact saturation
definitions.statement: For strong palettes K_a^circ,K_b^circ put Sat(D)=K_a^circ*D*K_b^circ, with all three factors nonempty exact and the finite D-meet nonempty.

definitions.name: Whole represented closure base
definitions.statement: A full exact same-sort relation containing identity has increasing positive powers stabilizing to an exact equivalence. A quotient identity is the whole original kernel K under inverse image.

definitions.name: Maximal original complement
definitions.statement: Y<X is the realized parity layer, K_* is inclusion-maximal exact with Y<=K_* and K_* intersect X=Y, and t_*=K_*;O;K_*.

definitions.name: Actual active gate classes
definitions.statement: K_s is the original reached full equivalence. Each active label lambda_s is constant on a whole K_s-class; rigid-arrow equations relate these quotient values.

definitions.name: Endpoint mask
definitions.statement: At active endpoints allowed old atoms are correct-character rigid arrows plus every nonrigid atom; with an inactive endpoint the whole typed palette is allowed. Id is allowed only at the same sort with equal bits.

definitions.name: Old finite-base one-point fibre
definitions.statement: For finite real A and x outside A, S=Aut(M/A).x is the definable realized complete one-point qf fibre, including inequalities to every point of A.

definitions.name: The actual legal marked age
definitions.statement: Finite objects are actual old-age complete diagrams with locally legal marks, equivalently restrictions of some actual global orbit-seed marking. Its homogeneous marked source is the Fraisse limit, not an arbitrary seed marking.

definitions.name: Guarded lifted STRONG normal form
definitions.statement: For a nonempty legal lifted diversity word w with old STRONG profile P_w, the new STRONG profile is P_w intersect the actual two-endpoint-bit mask. This is obtained by guarding the full normal form after SAP.

definitions.name: Whole-expanded orbital rank
definitions.statement: k_a counts current full-Aut nonidentity same-sort pair orbitals. Whole-expanded homogeneity identifies each such orbital with an occurring old binary colour in a fixed child sort.

definitions.name: Terminal integer potential
definitions.statement: Phi=sum_a 3^(k_a); each active parent is replaced by two nonempty children with at most k_a-1 old colours, giving strict decrease.

definitions.name: Actual-context sufficiency contract
definitions.statement: The source sufficiency lemma is prepared in its standing actual maximal-character/FULL triangle setting. The bare trio reduct-surjective/T/EPP is not asserted to characterize an arbitrary abstract marked subclass.

claims.name: Distribute the left STRONG gate over a nonempty meet
claims.statement: In A05 apply I01 to K_a^circ*(meet_i D_i), retaining NONEMPTY exact meet. This equals meet_i(K_a^circ*D_i). Each product is nonempty exact.

claims.statement: The common left-saturated meet is nonempty by C01. Apply I01 to right multiplication by K_b^circ to obtain meet_i(K_a^circ*D_i*K_b^circ)=K_a^circ*(meet_iD_i)*K_b^circ.

claims.statement: C02 proves only the supported STRONG theorem, with no assertion for empty intersections or AP-only collisions. It is not the full represented theorem I02.

claims.statement: On an actual homogeneous AP+HOM CCO shadow, apply I03 with its own logical equality as base. For full exact A,B containing that identity and meeting only there, stable exact closures meet only there. This statement is entirely represented.

claims.name: A quotient identity pulls back to the WHOLE kernel
claims.statement: If the actual shadow is a quotient, pullback of its identity is K. Full saturated products/intersections commute with actual pullback. Apply I03 directly to the original K-bisaturated full exact relations; no arbitrary old-to-quotient exact descent is asserted.

claims.name: Visible original parity supplies a nontrivial even gate
claims.statement: I04 supplies Y>Id, O disjoint from Y, [X:Y]=2 and stabilized full even/odd words. The additional inequality Y>Id uses original SAP, not abstract quotient algebra.

claims.name: Choose the actual maximal full exact complement
claims.statement: The finite exact-equivalence set contains Y, so choose maximal K_* with K_* intersect X=Y. I05 gives t_* nonidentity quotient involution, t_*;t_*=K_*, [K_* join X:K_*]=2 and the ORIGINAL maximal gate.

claims.name: Reach the finite actual rigid bridge groupoid
claims.statement: I06 supplies one path-independent reached kernel per named original sort, finite connected hom-sets, elementary abelian isotropy and actual free quotient action. This is full represented bridge geometry, not a STRONG identity completion.

claims.name: Transport the dominant involution without mixed descent
claims.statement: I07 conjugates original upper exact-equivalence intervals and t_*. It gives path-independent nonidentity t_s, dominance in all original exact equivalences above K_s, and therefore in all nonidentity full exact quotient equivalences by inverse image.

claims.name: The character is additive and detects each odd involution
claims.statement: Choose connectors; elementary abelian isotropy allows a linear functional with chi(t_*)=1. I08 gives chi(RS)=chi(R)+chi(S), chi(identity)=0 and chi(t_s)=1 independent of connector choices.

claims.name: Actual free-action seeds give global labels
claims.statement: I08 propagates one bit from a seed in each free groupoid-action orbit. Thus lambda(Rq)=lambda(q)+chi(R) simultaneously for all actual quotient points. Pull back to real points; bits are constant on each K_s-class.

claims.name: Rigid and nonrigid atoms have exactly their stated phase freedoms
claims.statement: An actual old atom inside a rigid quotient arrow has its forced chi difference; every other actual orbital joins different free-action orbits and admits both differences by independent seeds. This gives the literal mask D06 and finite reduct-surjective marking.

claims.name: Inactive sorts and logical identity keep their actual labels
claims.statement: An inactive sort has constant bit zero; with an inactive endpoint no old atom restriction is added. Original Id lies in the identity bridge with bit difference zero, whereas full K_s may also contain diversity atoms.

claims.name: Represented rigid-product factorisation
claims.statement: I09 factors nonempty represented exact A,B with AB inside one rigid bridge into compatible R1,R2, with constructed intermediate gate. If the intermediate sort were inactive, R1 would reach it, contradiction; hence both input character equations apply.

claims.name: FULL phase totality uses the actual maximal gate
claims.statement: Apply I10 C09 in this same original construction: an entirely wrong nonempty output saturates to an affine dS; the original dominant t_s with chi one kills nontrivial S in ker chi, and C14 contradicts wrong-character singleton bridge output. Id may be an output.

claims.name: Totality here is FULL, not yet a STRONG SAP argument
claims.statement: C15 asserts nonempty FULL allowed output. It does not exclude an Id-only output and is not used to claim marked SAP. The independent actual SAP proof comes first below.

claims.name: FULL EPP is the contrapositive of the proved mask primality
claims.statement: Suppose nonempty meet_i P_i of FULL represented reachable profiles lies in deterministic sheet delta, while no P_i lies wholly there. Each P_i then meets the opposite allowed mask (nonrigid atoms allowed). I10 C15 says their meet meets that opposite mask, contradiction. Hence some P_j is wholly in the given sheet.

claims.name: The full primality proof uses RAW nonempty saturation
claims.statement: Its expanded original proof sets E_i=K_a;P_i;K_b and uses I02 to preserve the NONEMPTY full meet. The common domain lies in the rigid hom-torsor and becomes one whole bridge by the original gate/affine argument inside I10. No STRONG theorem C03 is substituted here.

claims.name: Translate a full bridge to WHOLE K and separate closures
claims.statement: Right compose E_i by d^op. Nonempty RAW distribution and bridge identities give a common intersection K_a. A minimal family gives A,B strictly above K_a, with A intersect B=K_a. I03 separates their full stable closures, contradicting original dominant t_a in both. This expands the full EPP support with the correct base.

claims.name: FULL EPP source scope and empty family
claims.statement: C17 proves typed-epp for FULL represented profiles in its raw-pair-shadow reading. For zero profiles the intersection is typed Top; an active nontrivial character has both sheets, so Top is not contained in one sheet. No member is falsely selected from an empty list.

claims.name: RAW EPP is not automatically inherited by diversity slices
claims.statement: A RAW profile may additionally contain Id, so a nonempty STRONG intersection lying in a deterministic sheet need not make the full RAW intersection lie there. Therefore STRONG EPP requires the additional actual-SAP no-orthogonal-equivalences bridge C55-C59, not simple deletion of Id. The printed strong-saturation reference in the full EPP proof needs the RAW I02 qualification.

claims.name: Old SAP excludes real algebraicity outside finite bases
claims.statement: I12 C04 says Aut(M/A).u is infinite for every finite old real A and u outside A. Since finite-language full one-point qf fibres are definable, any finite definable old set over A is contained in A. No external model-theoretic algebraicity theorem is used.

claims.name: The source gate has infinite real classes
claims.statement: C06 gives K_*>=Y>Id. Thus every K_*-class contains at least two points by transitivity. If a class were finite, its definable class over one point would contain an outside-base algebraic point, contrary to C22. Hence all source K_*-classes are infinite.

claims.name: No reached gate is original equality
claims.statement: If a reached K_s were Id on the SAME source sort, reached-kernel path independence C08 would give K_s=K_*, contradiction C23. If it is a DIFFERENT named sort, a bridge from K_* to Id_s associates to each original source point a UNIQUE target real point. That point is fixed by its source-point stabilizer, lies in a disjoint sort, and contradicts C22. Thus K_s>Id at every active sort.

claims.name: All reached gate classes are infinite
claims.statement: For each active original sort use C24 and transitivity to get a nontrivial K_s-class. A finite class would again give an algebraic point outside a singleton real base, contrary to C22. Thus every active actual K_s-class is infinite.

claims.name: One-point old fibres over finite real bases are definable
claims.statement: For finite A and x outside A, completeness, finite palette, binarity and homogeneity identify S=Aut(M/A).x with its realized complete qf type: the finite conjunction of sort, spoke atoms and inequalities to A. In particular S is definable over A and avoids A.

claims.name: A type fibre meets its active gate class infinitely
claims.statement: Let C=K_s[x]. If S intersect C were finite nonempty, choose y in infinite C outside S union A using C25. Then the finite set S intersect K_s[y] is definable over A union {y}, contains x, and x lies outside that base. This contradicts C22. Thus S intersect K_s[x] is infinite.

claims.name: Infinitely many points retain the same expanded one-point type
claims.statement: In ANY one actual global marking extending a finite legal marked A+x, all points in S intersect K_s[x] have the SAME active bit as x by C11. Their old type over A agrees by C26. Thus they have the same expanded finite one-point type; for an inactive x the old infinite orbit S from C22 suffices because its bit is constant.

claims.name: Construct the actual homogeneous marked source using AP only
claims.statement: I11 gives the legal finite marked class, its ordinary AP/JEP and homogeneous marked Fraisse limit H, with old reduct M, reasonableness, precompactness and semantic HOM CCO. This construction neither assumes nor concludes SAP at this step.

claims.name: Transport arbitrarily many same-type witnesses into H
claims.statement: Given any actual finite marked A+x in H, realize it in some global marking of M by the legal-age contract I11. C28 supplies N distinct same-expanded-type points over that A. Their whole finite marked induced structure belongs to the legal age. Embed it into H and use H homogeneity to align its A+x copy with the original one.

claims.name: Every off-base H orbit is infinite
claims.statement: In C30, complete induced one-point maps over A between x and its N witnesses extend by H homogeneity. Thus Aut(H/A).x has at least N points for every N. This holds for every finite A and x outside A, including empty A and inactive sorts.

claims.name: The actual marked relational age has SAP
claims.statement: H has no functions, so every finite set is closed and cl(A)=A. Apply I13 C15 to C31: the entire hereditary age of H has SAP, using one simultaneous avoidance automorphism. This is a new proved consequence of old SAP plus infinite gates, not a relabelling of B044 ordinary AP.

claims.name: The SAP proof is independent of lifted STRONG sufficiency
claims.statement: C22-C32 prove actual marked SAP before any invocation of new-source STRONG associativity/Helly/injectivisation. They use old SAP, actual gates/markings, ordinary marked AP and actual marked homogeneity. Neither strong phase-primality nor a conclusion of the sufficiency lemma was assumed.

claims.name: Identify the marked age with its FULL lifted triangle class
claims.statement: A complete locally legal marked network has an actual old-age reduct by A03. Its pair masks satisfy all finite character equations, so I11 C41 realizes its marking. Conversely every age triangle is locally legal. Unary/pair admissibility handles fewer than three vertices. Thus the legal marked age is exactly the FULL lifted triangle class.

claims.name: The actual new full path product has the full normal form
claims.statement: Actual old and marked homogeneous pair orbitals are named atoms plus endpoint bits. The realized triangle types are precisely old actual triangles with the endpoint masks. Therefore full represented composition agrees with the formal recursion of the B044 path proof inside I11/I10, yielding full profile P_full intersect its actual endpoint mask, including allowed Id outputs.

claims.name: Guard both actual path products AFTER SAP
claims.statement: I12 applies to the original source by A02 and to H by independently proved C32. It identifies their STRONG profiles with their full represented profiles restricted to distinct endpoints. Guard C35 by endpoint inequality on BOTH sides to obtain L_strong=P_old,strong intersect mask. This does not assert strong EPP by deletion of Id.

claims.name: All legal lifted STRONG forks have diversity outputs
claims.statement: The actual H age has SAP. Align two realized lifted input edges over their common middle point and strongly amalgamate them, taking all three vertices distinct; the remaining pair gives an allowed diversity output. Thus totality of the STRONG lifted table is genuine, not merely FULL totality with a possible Id-only output.

claims.name: STRONG associativity and Peirce are actual new-source laws
claims.statement: Apply I15 to H, whose homogeneity and SAP are now proved. It gives the STRONG associativity/Set-Pasch laws; actual allowed triangle permutations give correctly typed Peirce with converses. No bare xor slogan is used as a substitute for associativity.

claims.name: Lifted positive STRONG profiles are two-Helly
claims.statement: H has actual homogeneity and SAP by C29/C32 and actual HOM CCO by I11. Hence I16 gives finite positive STRONG profile 2-Helly on every ordered pair of current child sorts. All mixed endpoint tags and inactive bits are retained.

claims.statement: O lies in the represented odd relation t_*=K_*;O;K_*, and chi(t_*)=1. Thus every old O pair has opposite new bits, while Y<=K_* has equal bits. This orients the selected orbital parity layer, not an arbitrary preassigned finite cover.

claims.statement: For an actual quotient point q, the nonidentity involution t_s sends it to a distinct quotient point and C10/C11 force opposite bits. Real representatives give an actual legal two-point marked diagram. It belongs to the marked age H, so both active child sorts are nonempty.

claims.name: The actual safe split preserves the structural source class
claims.statement: H is homogeneous with unchanged old reduct, finitely many named child sorts, inherited same-sort symmetry, and a FULL triangle-defined finite binary age by C34. It has SAP by C32 and HOM CCO by I11, is reasonable/reduct-surjective/precompact by I11, and orients the actual selected layer by C41.

claims.name: Whole expanded homogeneity identifies current pair orbitals
claims.statement: Within any fixed ordered pair of current child sorts, same old named colour defines an induced two-point isomorphism, which whole H homogeneity extends. Hence each occurring old colour there is ONE full current pair orbital; singleton homogeneity makes each realized child transitive. This is not a claim about arbitrary global seed markings.

claims.name: A realised phase-one colour is lost inside each active child
claims.statement: The actual two-point witness of C42 has distinct old real endpoints in the same parent and opposite phases. Its old diversity atom c_a occurs in t_s, so is absent from equal-bit pairs in either child. Whole H homogeneity prevents surviving colours from splitting inside a fixed child.

claims.name: The conditional integer rank lemma is discharged
claims.statement: C42 gives two nonempty children, C44 whole expanded homogeneous orbital recognition, and C45 a realized lost diversity colour on each active parent. All changes are unary, so inactive induced sorts stay unchanged. These facts instantiate EVERY hypothesis of I14, giving strict decrease of Phi=sum_a3^k_a.

claims.statement: C43 retains actual homogeneity, finitely many transitive sorts, finite complete symmetric binary language, SAP/HOM CCO and FULL triangle-definedness. Thus if a current sort has a residual finite relative interval, I04/C07 choose a fresh maximal exact character split at that current source.

claims.name: Finite descent rules out an infinite splitting sequence
claims.statement: Initial Phi is a finite positive integer. Every genuine split lowers it by at least one by C46, so there can be only finitely many nontrivial stages. This uses no later terminal Ramsey or full-language theorem.

claims.name: A terminal source has no finite relative cover
claims.statement: Continue while a proper finite relative interval remains. C47 would permit a further split if one remained at the final stage, contrary to C48. Hence every proper same-sort invariant cover has infinite relative index; finite invariant lattices turn any finite relative interval into a saturated cover chain.

claims.name: Finite unary composition preserves the original reduct and finite expansion
claims.statement: At each stage lift old embeddings by reasonableness, choose legal expansions by reduct-surjectivity and multiply finitely many label choices for precompactness. Composition changes only unary labels, so no added-function restriction issue arises. Every current source has SAP/HOM CCO by C43.

claims.name: Finite-cover elimination source export
claims.statement: C47-C50 prove finite precompact reduct-surjective reasonable unary terminalisation with SAP and HOM CCO and no proper finite-index same-sort covers. The numerical descent matches AP-only B044, but the SAP conclusion rests on C22-C32, not its AP theorem.

claims.statement: The saturation source theorem C03 is STRONG; closure, groupoid and typed EPP C04-C20 are FULL represented. claims.statement: Controls enumerate finite-window products, marked paths, finite saturation cases, labelled clone spans and integer ranks. They test bounded consequences and explicit identity distinctions, but do not prove the unbounded type-fibre argument, general exact geometry, infinite freshness or Lean proofs.

claims.statement: For A empty, S is an inhabited transitive old sort, and C25/C27 still give infinitely many same-phase witnesses. Inactive sorts use old off-base orbit infinitude. Actual unary/pair admissibility and nonempty endpoint sorts cover empty/singleton/two-point marked objects without triangle-only vacuity.

claims.name: Old SAP forbids two nontrivial orthogonal real equivalences
claims.statement: Suppose invariant equivalences E,F are both strictly above Id and E intersect F=Id. Choose x, a in E[x] minus {x}, and b in F[x] minus {x}. The meet condition makes a,b,x distinct. Then E[a] intersect F[b]={x}; it is definable over {a,b} and contains an outside-base singleton, contradicting C22. Thus two nontrivial real invariant equivalences cannot meet in Id.

claims.name: Lift a finite STRONG word family to RAW before taking its meet
claims.statement: For each nonempty original STRONG positive-word profile P_i take its corresponding RAW word relation R_i. I12 at the OLD SAP source gives P_i=R_i minus Id on a same-sort endpoint palette (and equality P_i=R_i across different sorts). Thus D=meet_i R_i has diversity slice exactly meet_i P_i. A nonempty strong common meet therefore makes D a nonempty full exact relation.

claims.name: A nonempty phase-one diversity meet cannot hide an extra RAW identity
claims.statement: Suppose same-sort D from C56 contains Id but its nonempty diversity slice lies wholly in phase one. K_s is phase zero, so D intersect K_s=Id. Both are full exact and contain Id; I03 with base Id gives <D> intersect K_s=Id. But D>Id makes <D>>Id, and C24 gives K_s>Id. This contradicts C55. Hence this sole dangerous extra-identity case is impossible. Same-sort symmetry makes D symmetric, while K_s is already a stable full exact equivalence, so the relative-Id closure-separation hypotheses match.

claims.name: Every other phase case transfers full EPP safely
claims.statement: If the common STRONG meet lies in phase zero, adding a possible RAW Id keeps the full meet in phase zero, so C20 gives some full R_j in that sheet and therefore its diversity P_j there. For phase one when the full meet has no Id, C20 applies directly. Cross-sort endpoint relations have no diagonal, so again full and strong meets agree. These cases together with C57 exhaust actual typed possibilities.

claims.name: Actual STRONG phase-primality with the extra SAP bridge
claims.statement: C56-C58 prove the typed-EPP implication ALSO for original nonempty positive STRONG profiles in the actual maximal-character instance. This uses old SAP through C55, not merely deleting Id. For an empty profile family, both deterministic sheets are nonempty: same-sort phase zero has K_s diversity by C25 and phase one has t_s, while different active sorts have arrows R and t_sR. Thus the full palette cannot satisfy the one-sheet hypothesis.
